freeze.semanticAcceptance: Unassessed against current fields; this is a frozen denominator, not proof or coverage.

01-mechanism: Physical injury, measured danger, acquired display, priming, access, natural recognition and distant control are separate. The all-T-cell shorthand needs conventional receptor scope.
A treated-lesion response, peptide-stimulated blood response and untreated-lesion response during systemic therapy do not isolate a local treatment contribution.
Galluzzi detection consensus and Trex1 dose/model qualifiers need actual source reading.
02-timing: Oligometastatic, progressive and residual categories require history, not only current count. ctDNA does not localise a safely targetable lesion.
FAST-Forward local noninferiority does not validate immune timing or turn every short course into SBRT.
The eight-to-two versus two-to-one-growing scan cards are fictional, not study entry rules.
03-overlap-and-sequencing: Keep BOOSTER selection, clock before randomisation, planned137/randomised65 and nonrandom cryo13/thermal31 contrasts separate.
PACIFIC chemoradiation then consolidation is not an SBRT or immune-mechanism experiment. CURB cohort differences and NRG-BR002 phaseII/no-phaseIII/HR-CI scope must be verified.
3/17 versus3/9 are the same numerator, with8earlyprogressiondeaths; neither supplies the missing drug-only randomised comparator.
No benefit in a table should become did-not-show-benefit at the actual uncertainty, not an exact-zero effect claim.
04-decision-questions: Local-procedure goal, evidence, geometry, exposure and alternatives are separate questions; this is not authorisation or a selection algorithm.
FDA129547 is nonclinical radiopharmaceutical guidance, not a patient dose protocol.
05-tissue-and-sample-budget: Both local original and later bodies read completely. The later version integrates the separately inventoried targeted-specimen predecessor.

Keep assay layers, finite-material permission/custody, viability and sampling denominators separate. Both fictional 10/50 versus10/20 and10/mm² versus10/.2mm² scenarios need arithmetic and field proofs.
targeted-04-decision-questions: Read in full. The body has EIGHT ordered questions, not a five-question framework; exact product/setting/action/evidence/access milestones and owners must remain distinct.

Fictional Q research-review action and postoperative manufacturing/treatment request differ in setting, commitments and missing premises. FDA CAR guidance cannot substantiate incidence for all engagers.
targeted-05-tissue-and-sample-budget: Read in full. FFPE request ledger separates held FFPE DNA extraction, rejected original-living-cell use, permitted image reuse and required reserve/input/permission checks. Four5micrometre sections are supplied fictional requirements, not standards.
A block return does not restore consumed sections; data permission is distinct from transfer/consumption permission.
06-comparisons: Full later body and full original diff read. Original teaching unchanged; links/next-step map differ.
BED15x2vs5x6 at assumedalpha/beta3/10 is50/90vs36/48; physical30each. Needs direct IAEA equation/assumptions and START estimates verification, not implicit dose recommendations.
ConventionalCD8scope and nonrandomizedcryo13/thermal31 comparison require bounded wording.
07-read-an-injected-treatment-study: Full later body read, original exact bytes will reuse by identity. Route table distinguishes injectedpayload, systemicdrug and otherlocalprocedure; electroporation a separate intervention component.
Invented12participants/8injected/2uninjected/5immune observations overlap, cannot sum15responders or inferformalpatientresponse, addedbenefit oraccess.
index: Full later body read; Applied-to-case paragraph is excluded, no patient content to enter public corpus.
Reading-map/navigation rows distinguished from unique teaching; surgerylocal scope and hypotheses/evidence ladder retained.
